snippet.title: Chained Together - New Map Reveal Trailer | The Triple-i Initiative
snippet.description:
Learn more about Chained Together: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2567870/Chained_Together/

You thought you’d escaped Hell. Think again.

Chained Together returns with an exclusive preview of a brand-new map coming this November. After climbing your way out of Hell, the community asked for more — and we listened. Grab your friends, chain yourselves together, and prepare to face whatever awaits beyond the escape in this chaotic 1–4 player co-op platformer. Coming to Steam, published by Secret Mode.

Chained Together Store Page:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2567870/Chained_Together/

Music:
Vision Heat – Her Way #3 – courtesy of Epidemic Sound
Rymdklang Soundtracks – Soul Reaper – courtesy of Epidemic Sound
https://www.epidemicsound.com/

--

Follow news and updates on The Triple-i Initiative:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/triple-i-initiative-2026 
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/iii-initiative.bsky.social 
Bilibili: https://space.bilibili.com/3546638813497663
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/iii_initiative/
Twitter: https://x.com/iii_initiative

What is the Triple-i Initiative?

We’re simply a bunch of studios banding together to share exciting news to our players, in a short show packed with back-to-back trailers. That’s it - no extra fluff, no ads, no host, just games. We’re talking world premieres, exclusive gameplay, launch dates, demo drops and more!

You can learn more at https://iii-initiative.com
